capabilities.reason: Offline construction only: no model call, tool execution or external service verification.

description: Interact with a running exec session created by exec with yield_time_ms. Use chars='' to poll without writing, chars to send stdin, close_stdin=true to send EOF, or terminate=true to stop the process. Use wait_for with wait_timeout_ms for dev servers, test watchers, and prompts where you need to wait for expected output. Do not use this to start new commands; start them with exec.

function.description: Interact with a running exec session created by exec with yield_time_ms. Use chars='' to poll without writing, chars to send stdin, close_stdin=true to send EOF, or terminate=true to stop the process. Use wait_for with wait_timeout_ms for dev servers, test watchers, and prompts where you need to wait for expected output. Do not use this to start new commands; start them with exec.
function.name: write_stdin

chars.description: Bytes/text to write to stdin. Omit or pass an empty string to only poll recent output.

close_stdin.description: Close stdin after writing chars. Useful for commands waiting for EOF.

max_output_chars.description: Maximum output characters to return from this poll (default 10000, max 50000).

max_output_tokens.description: Compatibility alias for max_output_chars. The current runtime uses a character budget.

session_id.description: Session id returned by exec when yield_time_ms is used.

wait_for.description: Optional text to wait for in output before returning. Useful for interactive commands and dev servers.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for wait_for text (default 10000, max 120000).

yield_time_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait before returning recent output (default 1000, max 30000).
